title: Entropy hunchbook — micro-eval notes
content:
Notes to self — fast brain dump from ad-hoc morning session

Goal: capture a few small, repeatable micro-evals and a lightweight rubric I can use to triage weird generative behavior. Want something quick to hand to SRE/infra if this spikes again (latency or repetition).

Context
- Observed subtle degradation after rolling quantization profile q8x2 -> q4_agg on model v0.9.1 -> v1.0.0 (dedicated). Most obvious symptom: bursts of short-token repetition and higher variance in top-k sampling behavior.
- Repro on small prompt sets (see examples below) across 3 seeds. Not universal but high enough to be worrying for chat flows.

Quick ad-hoc rubric (0-3 scale, integer only)
- Clarity (0 = garbage, 3 = crisp and actionable)
- Factuality (0 = hallucinates major facts, 3 = correct core facts)
- Coherence (0 = incoherent/inconsistent, 3 = logically coherent)
- Repetition / Echoes (0 = heavy repeated tokens/fragments, 3 = no repetition)
- Latency/Variance (0 = >2x baseline p95, 3 = within baseline)

Scoring example template (put scores and short notes):
- Prompt ID: E1-brief-summary
- Scores: [Clarity:2, Factuality:3, Coherence:2, Repetition:1, Latency:2]
- Notes: short loop of "and then" repeated 3x in the middle; p95 latency ~1.8x baseline on q4_agg variant.

Sample prompts + model outputs (seeded)
1) Prompt: "Summarize the key risks for a startup launching in 6 months."
- Baseline (v0.9.1, q8x2): "Key risks include product-market fit, runway, hiring, regulatory unknowns. Prioritize customer feedback loops and early sales."
- Post-rollout (v1.0.0, q4_agg): "Key risks include product-market fit and runway, and hiring and hiring and hiring. Prioritize customer feedback loops and early sales."
- Observations: repeated phrase "and hiring" repeated 3x. Token-level distribution shows abnormally high mass on the "and" token after position 28.

2) Prompt: "Explain differential privacy in plain terms."
- Baseline: normal, concise.
- Post: occasionally repeats short clause "keep data private" twice near the end. Lower perplexity but higher repetition score.

Diagnostic traces to capture if asked
- attention-sum snapshots for last 64 tokens
- KV-cache hit/miss counts (we suspect cache read-path differs with q4_agg kernels)
- sampling logits variance across temperature seeds
- p95/p99 latency breakdown per kernel and per layer

Hypotheses (ranked)
1) Quantization aggregation (q4_agg) changes low-level logits distribution leading to numerical rounding that amplifies local maxima -> repetition.
2) Batch scheduling change (slightly higher micro-batch sizes for dedicated pool) increases prefix-entropy variance once combined with new kernels.
3) KV cache truncate bug on certain stride boundaries after kernel swap (less likely but plausible).

Quick checks to run (low-effort)
- Re-run the 20-prompt micro-batch with v1.0.0 but with old quant profile (q8x2) pinned; compare repetition counts. (JIRA INF-1427 assigned)
- Run same prompts with temperature 0.0 and 0.2 to see if repetition persists at deterministic sampling.
- Enable per-token logits logging for 5 failing samples and grep for spikes.

Actionable triage steps (if customer impact)
1) Hotfix: revert quant profile for affected model alias -> rollback to q8x2 (short term).
2) Collect extended trace (3 seeds x 50 prompts) and attach to PR for runtime kernels.
3) Add a lightweight canary test (this rubric) into the rollout pipeline: if repetition score <2 on small sample, block.

Loose experimental notes (scratch)
- I saw latency p95 jumps concentrated in layer 12-14 in one run, but not consistently. Could be scheduling noise.
- Sampling logit variance correlated with repetition on ~60% of cases at temp 0.7. At temp 0.0 repetition still exists in ~10% of runs -> suggests deterministic amplification, not only sampling noise.
- Copied one failing output into GH issue for easier reference (link above).

Open questions / To-do (notes to self)
- Who owns quant profile rollouts? Ask infra/serving runtime lead (ping @ishaan).
- Add a short notebook (colab style) that reproduces E1/E2 with both quant profiles and records token dump; share with Sana.
- Should we add an "entropy drift" metric to our console? Quick heuristic: token-level top-1 mass variance over sliding window of 16 tokens. Low cost, might catch this earlier.

Random heuristics I want to keep
- If repetition >2 occurrences in sample of 10 prompts -> immediate M1 triage.
- Always save 3 seeds for failing prompt so infra can reproduce with different RNG.

Small backlog of follow-ups
- Draft a short "canary rubric" doc for product (1 page) that mirrors the above rubric so PMs understand the gating.
- Create a lightweight alert in Console metric engine: if repetition-rate across customer requests >0.5% for 1 hour, create an ops ticket.

Closing thought: this felt like a subtle numerical failure more than a prompt-engineering issue. Need to treat as infra/regression until proven otherwise.

-- Nikhil

(captured quick; will tidy and port to confluence if this becomes a persistent pattern)
